method.name: Analytical enumeration for bounded 2-var budget/effectiveness ILP
steps: Variables: X (channel X budget units, integer), Y (channel Y budget units, integer)
Since cost per unit effectiveness: X costs $5/pt, Y costs $6.67/pt — prefer X
Iterate X from max(0, 2000-3*1000) to 1000; for each X compute minimum feasible Y = max(0, ceil((2000-2X)/3))
Track minimum cost; verify integer solution

method.name: Direct MILP with PuLP: integer vars X,Y; constraints X+Y<=1000, 2X+3Y>=2000; minimize 10X+20Y
steps: Define integer variables X, Y with lower bound 0
Extract X, Y, objective value from solution
